description: This file defines a Validator class responsible for validating input data against specified rules in a Human Resource Management System project. It uses the Respect Validation library and includes methods for validation and filtering necessary values.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Provides static methods to validate input parameters based on provided rules, using Respect Validation library.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input values against a set of rules, throwing exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getOnlyNecessaryValues
methods.description: Filters input values to only include necessary keys, removing excluded parameters.
